decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: Stock A slot 1, Stock B slot 2, Stock C slot 3
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, none moved
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: Stock C; the others keep their colours and widths
the unit phrase on the top label: “$200 (share price)”; the top gridline starts after it
time axis: row 1 full, every second label, restarting in each group
time axis on two levels: row 2 Feb. 2022
comment 1 (“Stock C performed best during this peri…”) in empty space inside the plot, 1 arrow to c at 2022-02-24 (G8.7)
the maker's comments in New Computer Modern italic, in the reserved blue, set apart from the labelling and outside its count of text styles (G6.3, D-19)
the four questions answered: what matters: the title (not answered: why care, what explains it, what to do, which need be answered only where known) (G8.3)

source.shows: the book's raw share prices under the same comment: Stock C, the cheapest, looks flat, and the chart does not show that it performed best (R15-16)
